system_name: Atlas OS Supreme — Organizational Memory System (OMS) v1.0
architecture_principle: Every agent has short-term working memory. The organization has persistent, queryable, evolving long-term memory. Knowledge flows from working → short-term → long-term → retrieval → working.

layer_1_working_memory.name: Agent Working Memory (AWM)
layer_1_working_memory.persistence: Session-only. Auto-purged after task completion unless flagged for capture
layer_1_working_memory.technology: In-context learning within LLM inference context window

layer_2_short_term.name: Agent Short-Term Memory (ASTM)
layer_2_short_term.persistence: 30 days with auto-decay. Important items promoted to long-term

layer_3_long_term.name: Organizational Long-Term Memory (OLTM)
layer_3_long_term.persistence: Permanent with version history. Immutable audit trail
layer_3_long_term.technology: Hybrid: Vector DB + Knowledge Graph (Neo4j) + Document Store (S3 + Elasticsearch)
layer_3_long_term.embedding_model: text-embedding-3-large with custom fine-tuning on Atlas OS domain
layer_3_long_term.retrieval_latency: < 100ms for vector search; < 200ms for graph traversal
layer_3_long_term.cost: $0.05 per GB-month storage + $0.001 per 1K query tokens

layer_4_procedural.name: Procedural Memory (PM)
layer_4_procedural.scope: Organization-wide, encoded as executable workflows and runbooks
layer_4_procedural.capacity: Unlimited runbooks, workflows, and automation scripts
layer_4_procedural.technology: Git repository + Workflow engine (Temporal/Argo) + Runbook manager

knowledge_flow_pipeline.description: How knowledge moves from creation to organizational wisdom

stages.trigger: Task completion, incident resolution, experiment conclusion, discovery made
process: Agent flags insight during task closure (auto-prompted by system)
Raw insight is stored in agent's ASTM with metadata: timestamp, task ID, confidence, category
System extracts: what was learned, why it matters, how to reproduce, what to avoid
stages.technology: Structured extraction using Prompt Engineer templates + LLM inference

process: Knowledge Graph Agent checks for contradictions with existing knowledge
Model Evaluation Agent assesses confidence and evidence quality
If confidence < 0.7, insight is flagged for peer validation
Peer validation requires 2+ agents from different departments to confirm
Validated insights proceed; rejected insights are archived with reasoning
stages.technology: Contradiction detection via graph queries + ensemble validation scoring

process: Memory Architect classifies insight into taxonomy: Architecture, Business, Technical, Security, Marketing, etc.
Embedding Engineer generates domain-specific embeddings
Knowledge Graph Agent extracts entities and relationships
Vector DB Engineer stores embeddings with rich metadata
Document Store Engineer archives full context documents
stages.technology: Multi-modal indexing pipeline: vector + graph + full-text + structured metadata

process: Relevant agents are auto-notified based on their current tasks and interests
Weekly Knowledge Digest is generated by Research Agent for all agents
Critical insights are pushed to affected agents' ASTM immediately
Knowledge Base is updated with new articles and SOPs
Procedural Memory is updated if new workflows are required
stages.technology: Pub/sub notification system + RAG-based relevance scoring + digest generation

stages.trigger: Agent begins new task or encounters unknown situation
process: Agent queries OLTM with task description + current context
RAG Architect assembles relevant context from vector search + graph traversal + document retrieval
Retrieved knowledge is ranked by: recency, relevance, validation score, author authority
Top-K results are injected into agent's AWM as system context
Agent applies knowledge and logs effectiveness for feedback loop
stages.technology: Hybrid RAG: Dense retrieval (vector) + Sparse retrieval (BM25) + Graph traversal + Re-ranking model

process: Learning Agent continuously evaluates knowledge utility based on retrieval frequency and application success
Low-utility knowledge is demoted or archived (not deleted — organizational memory is immutable)
Contradictory evidence triggers knowledge update: old version is preserved, new version is promoted
Knowledge Graph Agent prunes stale relationships and adds new ones
Quarterly knowledge audits by Research Agent identify gaps and redundancies
stages.technology: Utility scoring model + automated graph maintenance + scheduled audit jobs

vector_database.index_type: HNSW with custom parameters for Atlas OS query patterns

knowledge_graph.schema: Dynamic schema with core entity types: Agent, Task, Knowledge, System, Component, Strategy, Experiment, Incident
knowledge_graph.query_interface: Cypher + natural language via GraphQL API
knowledge_graph.update_frequency: Real-time for critical knowledge; batch for bulk updates

document_store.storage: AWS S3 / GCS with lifecycle policies
document_store.versioning: Git LFS for large assets; standard Git for text

embedding_pipeline.fine_tuning: Quarterly fine-tuning on Atlas OS corpus using Fine-Tuning Specialist

retrieval_api.rate_limiting: 1000 queries/minute per agent; burst to 5000 for CEO
retrieval_api.caching: Redis cluster with 1-hour TTL for frequent queries

steps: Query OLTM for relevant knowledge using task description
Retrieve agent's own ASTM for recent related work
Load applicable SOPs from Procedural Memory
Assemble context window with: task + relevant knowledge + SOPs + recent history
Log context assembly for Memory Architect optimization
on_task_start.knowledge_injection_ratio: 60% task context, 25% organizational knowledge, 15% agent history

steps: Queue for validation and long-term promotion
Update agent's skill profile in Knowledge Graph
Notify dependent agents of relevant new knowledge
Memory Architect archives old agent profile
Knowledge Graph updates entity relationships for new capabilities
Vector DB re-indexes agent's knowledge corpus
Dependent agents are notified of capability changes
Training materials are updated for new agent version

data_classification.encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit

audit_trail.storage: Append-only blockchain-style log (Amazon QLDB or equivalent)
audit_trail.compliance: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing), SOX 404 (Internal Controls), ISO 27001

privacy_controls.right_to_be_forgotten: Agent-level memory purge possible; organizational knowledge is anonymized, not deleted
privacy_controls.data_minimization: Only task-relevant knowledge is injected into agent context
privacy_controls.purpose_limitation: Knowledge is tagged with allowed use cases; cross-purpose access requires approval

scalability_targets.scaling_strategy: Horizontal sharding by department + vertical partitioning by knowledge type. CDN for procedural memory. Edge caching for frequently retrieved knowledge.
